daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo has nominated Destry Damayanti as the next Bank Indonesia Governor, forwarding her name to the DPR for approval. The State Secretary confirmed there are no cabinet reshuffle plans currently under consideration by the president. The nomination comes as markets respond positively to policy continuity signals from the administration.

  • The KPK detained four suspects in the Bank BJB advertising procurement corruption case, which allegedly caused Rp 223.6 billion in state losses, and may re-examine former governor Ridwan Kamil following these detentions.
  • The KPK revealed that suspects in the Bank BJB case attempted to condition BPK audits through cash payments and seized 12,000 Singapore dollars from an envelope the Kuansing regent intended for Environment Minister Raja Juli Antoni.
  • PKS stated it will focus on supporting the government before engaging in 2029 presidential election calculations, despite Prabowo's high electability ratings.
  • Hanura is targeting completion of its structural consolidation by September 2026 in preparation for the 2029 elections.
  • Home Minister Tito announced that PPPK workers cannot be furloughed and revealed two options for hiring honorarium teachers in 2027 as either local government or Education Ministry civil servants.
  • The DPD speaker said the annual session links regions to the national agenda, emphasizing regional representation in policymaking.
  • Police announced an investigation into two individuals over alleged defamation related to President Prabowo's speeches, prompting legal debate over the basis for designation as suspects.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The TNI deployed helicopters to evacuate civilians from the Ugimba conflict zone in Intan Jaya, Papua, as part of ongoing security operations in the restive region. The Ministry of Social Affairs and Komnas HAM agreed to accelerate handling of thousands of internally displaced persons in Central Papua. These evacuations underscore continuing security challenges in Indonesia's easternmost provinces.

  • Indonesia's fire control efforts aim to prevent transboundary haze affecting neighboring countries as the government battles wildfires across 107,000 hectares.
  • The Indonesian embassy in Tunis highlighted historical and revolutionary values ahead of Indonesia's Independence Day celebrations.
  • KP2MI and IOM are preparing updated cooperation on migrant worker protection to strengthen safeguards for Indonesians working abroad.
  • Indonesia named a 10-member archery squad for the Asian Games with a silver medal target.

Other

The BNN and joint forces seized 1.3 tons of ketamine in Riau Islands waters, a major narcotics interdiction that drew praise from Gerindra and DPR members. Customs and police also foiled smuggling of 30 kilograms of methamphetamine from Malaysia in Asahan waters. The massive drug busts highlight Indonesia's ongoing battle against international narcotics trafficking through its maritime borders.

  • The rupiah strengthened sharply following President Prabowo's nomination of Destry Damayanti as BI Governor.
  • President Prabowo ordered coordinated responses to nationwide wildfires, with the Coordinating Minister for Political, Legal and Security Affairs confirming that the Jokowi-era policy to dismiss regional police and military chiefs who fail to handle forest fires remains in effect.
  • Indonesia launched a national movement to restore natural ecosystems with presidential backing, while also preparing weather modification operations to combat forest fires.
  • The government will issue a presidential regulation on online motorcycle taxi drivers before August 17, designating their status as UMKM (micro, small and medium enterprises).
  • Indonesia made its first marinated catfish export to Taiwan, expanding its agricultural trade footprint in East Asia.
  • The ATR/BPN and Home Affairs ministries agreed to integrate business identification numbers with property tax object numbers to streamline land administration.
